name: Sun Yat-sen
role: Chinese revolutionary; first provisional president of the Republic of China (1912); founder of the Kuomintang
summary: Sun Yat-sen led the revolution that ended the Qing monarchy and built his politics on the Three Principles of nationalism, popular sovereignty and the people's livelihood. He proposed a republic reached through military rule and party tutelage, with a five-Yuan government, examinations and local self-government, and state-led industrial development financed by foreign capital. He rejected Marxian class struggle while cooperating with Soviet Russia.
